meta.description: Comprehensive guide for visualizing ENCODE data including deeptools heatmaps, IGV screenshots, UCSC track hubs, and publication-quality plots. Use when users need to create visualizations of ChIP-seq signal, peak landscapes, genome browser views, or any visual representation of ENCODE data. Trigger on: heatmap, visualization, genome browser, track hub, IGV, deeptools, signal plot, peak visualization, profile plot, publication figure, bigWig visualization.
